name: Gaurab Pokharel
role: PhD candidate in Computer Science, Virginia Tech
headline: I study how people and algorithms share decisions about scarce public resources.
intro: Most of my work is on homelessness services, where a caseworker can overrule what an algorithm recommends. I ask when those overrides help and how caseworkers ration them. I also test whether a language model can be trusted to rank people at all.
